title: BRI Student Fellowship
description: Six-month leadership and civil-society-skills program for high school juniors and seniors. 20 fellows selected per cohort, meeting twice a month (90-minute sessions) and concluding with a week-long capstone experience in Philadelphia, PA or Washington, D.C. title: TechGirls
organization: Legacy International (U.S. Department of State Bureau of Educational and Cultural Affairs exchange program)
description: Fully-funded U.S. State Department exchange program for young women (ages 15-17) interested in STEM: a 23-day U.S.-based experience (university tech training plus community immersion) combined with a roughly 7-month mentoring program before and after the exchange. Between 2012 and 2025 engaged over 900 young women across 38 countries. Program identity and eligibility confirmed directly from the official site; exact current-cycle application dates were not confirmed from the fetched page.
selectivity_evidence: National/international competitive selection process across participating countries for a limited cohort each year.
